title: libdxfrw fast-test topology and FreeCAD block-consumer risk
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement

localScope.head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
localScope.worktreeState: Broadly modified and uncommitted; preserve unrelated existing changes.
localScope.change: Refined existing fast-validation and composed FreeCAD consumer gates using current LibreCAD test-target architecture and FreeCAD issue #25451 as a route-specific failure shape. No local codec defect was inferred and no issue sample was fetched or committed.

sources.observation: Current master isolates a parser-only library target from the large application archive; groups fast DWG and DXF tests; offers per-translation-unit opt-in executables; isolates fixture/external-data DWG tests; and uses a smaller writer-focused archive for a targeted HANDSEED test. The root CMake requests C++17.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Mutable upstream build configuration; it describes architecture, not measured build-time improvement or a requirement to change standalone libdxfrw's C++14 contract.
sources.disposition: Use the smallest owning target per slice, grouped fast format suites at subsystem boundaries, and slow/corpus/full-app suites at composed checkpoints. Preserve the standalone public C++14 compatibility gate.

sources.observation: Open issue #25451 carries a confirmed-status label and reports missing/misplaced blocks across multiple import-as modes, with text/dimension members rejected inside block definitions. The reporter says exploding selected blocks improves but does not fix the result. The report's attachments were not fetched. FreeCAD's documentation states the C++ importer skips text, dimensions, and attributes inside blocks; the legacy importer is a distinct route.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Consumer-side report and documented importer scope; no local libdxfrw reproduction, producer-authored wire rule, or current native-app run.
sources.disposition: At the composed native checkpoint, generate a local nested/transformed-block DXF control, pin the exact FreeCAD backend/preferences, compare direct baseline and candidate-emitted DXF, and classify documented omissions as consumer limits. Never use the attached customer files as fixtures.

implementationReadiness.localApplicability: Refines PAR-07/S8, PAR-14, PAR-49, PAR-59, PAR-144, and Phase 6 validation cadence. Keep parser/writer-local semantic assertions separate from FreeCAD consumer behavior; preserve existing ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary-membership next slice.
